# gitlab_compliance_framework_from_template (Resource)

The `gitlab_compliance_framework_from_template` resource manages the lifecycle of a compliance framework created from a template on top-level groups.

There can be only one `default` compliance framework. Of all the configured compliance frameworks marked as default, the last one applied will be the default compliance framework. This may be a different framework with every apply, so you should only use the default once per config.

-> This resource requires a GitLab Enterprise instance with an Ultimate license.

**Upstream API**: [GitLab GraphQL API docs](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/graphql/reference/#mutationcreatecomplianceframeworkfromtemplate)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gitlab_compliance_framework_from_template" "sample" {
  namespace_path = "top-level-group"
  template_id    = "gid://gitlab/ComplianceManagement::Frameworks::TemplateRegistry::Template/soc2"
}

# Example: create from template and override template defaults
resource "gitlab_compliance_framework_from_template" "sample_with_overrides" {
  namespace_path = "top-level-group"
  template_id    = "gid://gitlab/ComplianceManagement::Frameworks::TemplateRegistry::Template/iso_27001-2022"
  name           = "HIPAA"
  description    = "A HIPAA Compliance Framework"
  color          = "#87BEEF"
  default        = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace_path` (String) Full path of the namespace to add the compliance framework to.
- `template_id` (String) Unique identifier of the template to create the framework from.  In the format of: `gid://gitlab/ComplianceManagement::Frameworks::TemplateRegistry::Template/<template id>`

### Optional

- `color` (String) Override the color of the compliance framework in hex format. e.g. #FCA121.
- `default` (Boolean) Set this compliance framework as the default framework for the group. Default: `false`
- `description` (String) Override the description of the compliance framework.
- `name` (String) Override the name of the compliance framework.

### Read-Only

- `framework_id` (String) Globally unique ID of the compliance framework.
- `id` (String) The ID of this Terraform resource. In the format of `<namespace_path>|<framework_id>|<template_id>`.

## Import

Starting in Terraform v1.5.0, you can use an [import block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import `gitlab_compliance_framework_from_template`. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = gitlab_compliance_framework_from_template.example
  id = "see CLI command below for ID"
}
```

Importing using the CLI is supported with the following syntax:

```shell
# Gitlab compliance frameworks created from templates can be imported with a key composed of `<namespace_path>|<framework_id>|<template_id>`, for example:
terraform import gitlab_compliance_framework_from_template.sample "top-level-group|gid://gitlab/ComplianceManagement::Framework/12345|gid://gitlab/ComplianceManagement::Frameworks::TemplateRegistry::Template/soc2"
```
